Number of VA loans issued in New Mexico increased by 21.5% from Q3 2025 to Q3 2026
The U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) issued 1,448 home loans in New Mexico, totaling $520.8 million, during the third quarter of the fiscal year 2026, according to figures provided by the Veterans Affairs Home Loans Index.
The U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) issued 1,448 home loans in New Mexico, totaling $520.8 million, during the third quarter of the fiscal year 2026, according to the Veterans Affairs Home Loans Index.
In the same quarter of the previous year, New Mexico issued 1,192 home loans, totaling $414.2 million.
The VA assists service members, veterans and eligible surviving spouses to achieve homeownership through loans provided by banks and mortgage companies.
A portion of the loan is guaranteed by the VA, which allows the lender to provide better rates.
Several VA housing programs can help eligible individuals buy, build, or repair their homes. These include Purchase Loans, Interest Rate Reduction Refinance Loans (IRRRL), and Adapted Housing Grants, which are designed for veterans with service-connected disabilities.
| Quarter | Number of Loans | Total Loan Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Q3 2026 | 1,448 | $520.8 million |
| Q3 2025 | 1,192 | $414.2 million |
Information in this article was obtained from the Veterans Affairs Home Loans Index. The source data can be found here.
